AGENDA
  GLENDALE PLANNING HEARING OFFICER
  Municipal Services Building
  633 E. Broadway, Room 105
  Glendale, CA 91206
Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the City webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, Amazon Fire, iOS and
Android devices using a free app called Cablecast and choosing "Glendale TV" from the menu.
Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas.
Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. For public comments and questions during the
meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a specific agenda item will be taken when that
agenda item is discussed. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for
assistance, please contact the City Clerk at (818) 548-2090 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. The City Clerk’ office should be notified 72 hours (three
business days) or as soon as practicable for requests regarding sign language translation and
Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are
received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review
in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting or as soon as
practicable. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak
in their native language.

GLENDALE PLANNING HEARING OFFICER
 GLENDALE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT
  PUBLIC HEARING MINUTES
  MAY 14, 2025
 9:30 a.m.  Ms. Aileen Babakhani, Planning Hearing Officer, opened the hearing in
  Room 105 of the Municipal Services Building. She outlined the
  requirements of Title 30 for the pertinent cases and described the
  provisions for appeal in Title 30 of the Glendale Municipal Code as well as
  the procedures for the conduct of the hearings.

  Ms. Babakhani announced that the agenda for the meeting was
  posted on May 7, 2025, at the City Hall Entrance.

 Staff Members Present – Community Development Department
 1) Ms. Aileen Babakhani, Planning Hearing Officer (heard 2233 Honolulu Avenue)
 2) Ms. Cassandra Pruett, Case Planner (heard 317 West Palmer Avenue)
 3) Ms. Shoghig Yepremian, Case Planner

 NOTE: AGENDA ITEMS WERE HEARD OUT OF ORDER

(1) LOCATION:  2233 HONOLULU AVENUE

  ➢ PARKING REDUCTION PERMIT CASE NO. PPRP-000190-2022

 APPLICANT:  Permit Processing Consulting, LLC

 ZONE:  “CR” - Commercial Retail

 LEGAL DESCRIPTION: Lot 68, Tract No. 1701/ APN 5807-010-001.

 PROJECT DESCRIPTION
 The applicant is requesting a Parking Reduction Permit to allow approximately 4,906
 square foot general office use within the existing commercial building in the CR
 Commercial Retail Zone.

 APPLICANT’S PROPOSAL
 The applicant is requesting a Parking Reduction Permit to allow approximately 4,906
 square foot general office use within the existing commercial building in the CR
 Commercial Retail Zone.
  Planning Hearing Officer Minutes  2
 MAY 14, 2025

 CODE REQUIRES
 Approval of a Parking Reduction Permit is required to allow general office use
 (4,906 square feet) within an existing commercial building without providing 13
 parking spaces on-site.

 ENVIRONMENTAL DETERMINATION
 The project is categorically exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act
 (CEQA) as a Class 1 “Existing Facilities”, per Section 15301 of the CEQA
 Guidelines, because the project involves minor alterations at the interior of an
 existing building and does not include expansion of the footprint or floor level of
 the building.

 Staff
 - Ms. Shoghig Yepremian, Senior Planner and case planner on the proposed project,
 overviewed the staff report. She answered questions from the Planning Hearing Officer.

 Applicants
 - Mr. Armik Shahnazarians, c/o. Permit Processing and Consultant, LLC, architect and
 consultant on the project, and representing the owner, presented the proposed case. He
 answered questions from the Planning Hearing Officer.
 - Mr. Dominique Jeramaz Wizelman, owner, Montrose Plaza, LLC, presented the proposed
 case. He answered questions from the Planning Hearing Officer.
 - Mr. Jano Baghdanian, traffic consultant on this proposed project, presented the traffic
 aspects of the proposed project. He answered questions from the Planning Hearing Officer.

 WRITTEN PUBLIC INPUT

 SPEAKING AT THE HEARING
 In Favor:  No one.
 Interested Party: No one.
 In Opposition:  No one.

 CALLERS:  None.

 The case was taken under submission for a decision to be made at a later date.

(2) LOCATION:  317 WEST PALMER AVENUE

  ➢ CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CASE NO. PCUP-003877-2024

 APPLICANT:  Simon Dovlatyan
 Planning Hearing Officer Minutes  3
MAY 14, 2025

ZONE:  “R-2250” - Medium Density Residential

LEGAL DESCRIPTION: Lot 5, Berthoud Tract/ APN 5640-009-004.

PROJECT DESCRIPTION
The applicant is requesting approval of a Conditional Use Permit to allow a new
private pre-school within an existing 2,773 square foot building (previously
occupied by a church and childcare nursery) and to demolish a detached garage
at the rear to create a landscaped open space activity area on a 7,279 square
foot lot, located in the R-2250 (Medium Density Residential) Zone.

CODE REQUIRES
1) Approval of a Conditional Use Permit for the proposed new private pre-school
  in R-2250 Medium Density Residential Zone.

APPLICANT’S PROPOSAL
1) To allow a new private pre-school (60 students) within an existing 2,773
  square foot building.

ENVIRONMENTAL DETERMINATION
The project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) as a
Class 3 “new construction or conversion of small structures”, per Section 15303 of
the CEQA Guidelines, because the project involves a new 2,773 square foot
private pre-school within an existing building.

Applicants
- Mr. Danny Manasserian, project consultant, and representing the owner,
presented the case. He answered questions from the Planning Hearing Officer.

- Ms. Lianna Navassardian, project consultant presented the proposed case. She
answered questions from the Planning Hearing Officer.

-  Mr. Suren Dovlatyan, applicant, presented the case. He answered questions from
  the Planning Hearing Officer.

-  Mr. Steve Gezalyan, owner, presented the case. He answered questions from the
  Planning Hearing Officer.

-  Mr. Vardan Kasemyan, designer on the proposed project. presented the case. He
  answered questions from the Planning Hearing Officer.

- Ms. Lilit Akopian, owner, spoke in favor of the project.

- Mr, Stepan Gezalyan, owner, spoke in favor of the project.
 Planning Hearing Officer Minutes  4
MAY 14, 2025

- Mr. Jano Baghdanian, traffic consultant on this proposed project, presented the traffic
aspects of the proposed project. He answered questions from the Planning Hearing Officer.
